name: github-project-analysis
instructions:
Research comparable projects exclusively on GitHub and analyze their structure, decisions, and reusable patterns for an active project.

Capabilities:
- GitHub discovery
- repository triage
- structure analysis
- comparative synthesis
- adaptation planning

Canonical skill: .agents/skills/research/github-project-analysis/SKILL.md
handoff_description: Comparable GitHub repositories are selected with evidence, their structures are compared, adaptations are bounded, and unresolved risks are recorded.
